title: Chapter 7034: Kill Who First?

Chapter 7034: Kill Who First?

Chapter 7034: Kill Who First?

“I was just loyal, that’s all, you’re the despicable one.” He angrily said.

“Loyal? Were they your brothers? Kindred spirits? Or perhaps allies on the battlefield previously?” Li Qiye asked.

“No.” He lowered his head and said dejectedly: “Fine, I was a fool, everyone else was just acting except me.”

“They weren’t acting, just that they read the situation and fled.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose it had nothing to do with others. I just didn’t like the villainous heaven and wanted to cut him down.” He said.

“What’s the reason for the dislike?” Li Qiye asked.

“He had never lived in this world for a single day. What gives him the right to suppress others and make all the decisions?” He asked.

“You know he had earned the right. It was a matter of personal vendetta.” Li Qiye said.

“I despise the imperious act, always ready to throw down tribulations.” He angrily said.

“The tribulations happen for a reason, you know this.” Li Qiye said earnestly.

He opened his mouth but only let out a sigh. He eventually said: “I never cared about the tribulations, they were insignificant to me. I was actually happy to receive some for the challenge.”

“The perfect life, an ultimate talent for cultivation.” Li Qiye smiled.

“They spiced up my boring cultivation path.” He looked up at the sky and said what was on his mind: “However, my parents couldn’t make it through and I couldn’t help them. The tribulations became less fun afterward.”

“Your heart grew heavy, that’s why.” Li Qiye tapped his shoulder.

“Because no one was left to shoulder my burden.” He said.

“You have to know when to be content.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose I should be content. So many storms and burdens sheltered from me at the start.” He said before patting Li Qiye back: “Haha, this is where it is bad for you, no one can shoulder your burden of wanting to protect your epoch.”

“Feeling itchy?” Li Qiye only smiled in response.

“Haha, just kidding.” He smiled wryly.

“I am a passerby now, they will have to shoulder the burden.” Li Qiye said.

“The way is paved, not much bitterness is left.” He shrugged.

“Did you ever think about what you would do after becoming the high heaven?” Li Qiye asked.

“Uhh...” He said: “I haven’t thought about it before dying, just wanted to kill him first and then think. Now, there’s no need to waste my time, what about you?”

“Didn’t I say I would return everything to the world?” Li Qiye said.

“Mmm...” He contemplated for a long time before asking: “Others won’t agree for sure, they just want to replace the high heaven.”

“That’s the goal for most cultivators in history.” Li Qiye said.

“Even if they don’t become the high heaven, they won’t return anything. Plus, the moment you leave, a new high heaven will appear to reap your rewards.” He said.

“That’s why those who deserve to die must die.” Li Qiye said.

“All of them?” He asked.

“It depends on them.” Li Qiye said.

“Then you’ll be busy. You have An Ran, Octopus, and Hidden Immortal. These three must be dealt with first before anyone else. An Ran might be easiest since he will duel you openly. The other two? Problematic, especially Hidden Immortal.” He said.

“How so?” Li Qiye asked.

“You will never find the bastard. He’s probably no one, just a bag of skin.” He said.

“A bag of skin?” Li Qiye had a serious expression.

“He makes Octopus look trustworthy.” He continued: “Although Octopus is always hiding, he does carry out his promise. For example, risking his life to drag that thing back from the nine worlds. As for Hidden Immortal...”

“Go on.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Putting on airs, flashy but hollow, veiled and evasive in both actions and words. He spoke as if he were incomparably powerful yet never took the field, just hiding behind Dragongrasp. I suspect he’s borrowing someone else’s body.”

“Dragongrasp.” Li Qiye furrowed his brows.

“Unfamiliar, right? Same for me, he was the commander of Immortal Hunt Alliance but looked more like a useless fool.” He said.

“A celestial fool?” Li Qiye shook his head.

“That’s not what I meant. Sure, he’s a celestial immortal, there’s no denying it. Of course, far weaker than I am. However, I sensed something hollow within, potentially possessed by Hidden Immortal. It’s a pity Heavenfall and the others didn’t let me do anything such as ripping him up to take a look.” He said.
